VoiceCallRecordingStructure.name: VoiceCallRecordingStructure
VoiceCallRecordingStructure.description: Represents the structure of a voice call recording, which includes voice call participants, speaking order, start offset, and end offset.

ListenRatio.description: Required. The ratio of the time the speaker spent listening versus talking on the call.

Name.description: The name of the voice call recording.

ParticipantSpeakingOrder.description: Required. The sequence in which participants first spoke during the call. Only the initial speaking turn of each participant is captured.

TalkRatio.description: Required. The ratio of the time that the speaker spent talking versus listening on the call.

TalkSegment.description: The transcript of specific segments that the participant was speaking.

VoiceCallId.description: Required. ID of the associated VoiceCall.

VoiceCallRecordingId.description: Required. ID of the associated VoiceCallRecording.

VoiceCallRecordingStructure.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set
